1.note: Alfasi's gloss on הוצא (here rendered 'lattice or fence of reeds') is obscure; the exact sense of שבכא in this context is uncertain.

2.he: החכם הכוכבי בעל ס' מגדל דוד
2.note: David ben Samuel ha-Kokhavi of Provence, author of Sefer ha-Battim, of which Migdal David is a part.

3.note: Judah Hayyat's commentary on Ma'arekhet ha-Elohut; 'Ma'arekhet ha-Aherot' presumably refers to a section of that work, but the exact identification is uncertain.

4.note: The author's chapter numbering; in modern editions Herod's opening of David's tomb is Antiquities 16.7.1 (16.179–187). Number kept as given.
